en.title: Me, Sweets, and the Secret of the Magic Bakery
en.premise: I pour my heart and soul into baking delicious bread every single day at the "Sweet Memory" bakery! But there's a strange rumor floating around this town: they say if you visit "Promise Hill," you can rediscover memories of the "Vanished Village" through the taste of sweet treats... Then, one day, a mysterious boy with no memories arrives. Little do I know, the pastries I bake are about to set his frozen time in motion!

zh.title: 《我、甜点与魔法面包店的秘密》
zh.premise: 我在“甜蜜回忆”面包店工作，每天都倾注全力烘焙美味的面包！不过，这座小镇流传着一个奇特的传闻：只要前往“约定之丘”，就能伴随着甜美的点心，找回那座曾经存在过的“消失之村”的记忆……直到某天，一名失去了记忆的神秘少年来到了店里，而我亲手制作的烘焙点心，竟开始让那停滞的时间重新流动起来！
